title: 8. Aṭṭhakapuggalapaññatti
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Tattha katame cattāro maggasamaṅgino, cattāro phalasamaṅgino puggalā? Sotāpanno, sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno; sakadāgāmī, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno; anāgāmī, anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno; arahā, arahattaphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno; ime cattāro maggasamaṅgino, ime cattāro phalasamaṅgino puggalā.
